review_method: Coordinator read all fifteen primary-source-backed scenario designs, including workflow boundaries, decisions, independent case derivations and explicit source-versus-sample policy distinctions.
authorization_scope: Build synthetic workflows, data, independent expected results, no-Creator baselines, complete how-to documents and videos from actual baseline traces. This does not attest native generation, installation or invocation.

scenarios: Incoming-lot quality evidence and disposition review
Supplier delivery performance and shortage expediting review
BOM material-readiness and kitting shortage review
Site essential-document completeness and expiry review
Store, product and date promotion price audit
Delivery, proof-of-delivery and carrier charge review
Approved time and expense billing-draft review

build_acceptance.required_cases: One demo, two materially changed holdouts, and at least two negatives covering malformed records and contradictory evidence.
build_acceptance.oracle_rule: Derive expected business outputs independently before baseline execution; never copy baseline or generated-plugin results into goldens to make them pass.
build_acceptance.procedure_rule: One complete HOW_TO.md per scenario with all input/output fields, full result envelope, exact numerical/date/ordering rules, exceptions, human review and no-plugin versus plugin procedure.
build_acceptance.trace_rule: Actual executed stages, all six stage kinds, meaningful intermediate decisions and complete final outputs. No storyboard substituted for execution.
build_acceptance.video_rule: Readable short synthetic baseline execution visualization from actual trace, with encoding/timing/hash/fidelity evidence. Not a live ERP/POS/LIS/Cowork recording.
build_acceptance.native_input_rule: Only the approved procedure/workflow/connection metadata, demo input and video; withhold baseline code, goldens, holdouts and evaluation answers.

native_status.reason: Approved Computer Use tools must be restored AND an unlocked accessible session must be available. No alternate UI/private API/cookie/token/shell workaround.
native_status.prior_publication_result: UNKNOWN; inspect actual Installed state before any retry after access restoration.
native_status.output_directory_rule: Store actual native-generated plugins only after native generation. Do not fill output with locally generated substitutes or fake pass evidence.
